name: @esamagri/config
description: Environment-variable schemas and fail-fast loaders shared by apps/api, apps/customer-web, and apps/admin-web (Phase 3B STEP 2). No app should read process.env / import.meta.env directly for a required setting — it goes through the matching loader here, which validates shape and fails immediately with a clear error instead of the app starting in a half-configured state. This package holds no secret values itself, only their names, types, and validation rules.
